profile: Sprint Bioscience is a Swedish drug-discovery company developing preclinical small-molecule programs, primarily for solid tumors, using fragment-based drug discovery. Its portfolio targets tumor metabolism, the tumor microenvironment and immuno-oncology, with programs including VRK1, VPS34, NNMT, DCPS and STK25; NNMT also addresses chronic kidney disease. It licenses programs to pharmaceutical partners and has an AI-platform agreement with Lilly TuneLab.
